faq.headline: Frequently asked questions from partners and corporate clients

items.question: How high is the referral commission?
items.answer: The commission is agreed individually based on order volume and frequency, and paid for every referred job that completes. We give you the specific terms in an initial call — request a callback for that.

items.question: Who qualifies as a referral partner?
items.answer: Estate agents, relocation services, property managers, refurbishment consultants and anyone regularly advising clients with moving, clearance or renovation needs. You send the lead, we handle consultation, quote and delivery.

items.question: What does priority scheduling mean?
items.answer: Requests from partners and corporate clients are scheduled first. That matters most for tenant changes at month-end, when capacity in Munich is tight.

items.question: Do I get a dedicated contact?
items.answer: Yes. You get one fixed contact across all three brands — moving, clearance and renovation — instead of rotating responsibility per trade.

items.question: How do partner rates for corporate clients work?
items.answer: Instead of one-off quotes we agree fixed, discounted terms for recurring work. That makes your budgeting predictable and removes the quoting phase from every job.

items.question: Can you handle several units at once?
items.answer: Yes. For property managers and real-estate companies we handle multiple units in parallel or in series, on one schedule and with one contact.

items.question: How quickly is a unit re-lettable?
items.answer: With a tightly sequenced process — clearance, damage repair, painting, final cleaning — a standard flat is usually ready to let within a week. Split across several firms the same steps typically take two to four weeks.

items.question: Is there a minimum order volume?
items.answer: No. Partner terms are based on expected regularity, not a fixed minimum. Smaller property managers receive fixed prices and priority dates too.
